n_p1: Two days later, all the people who left Montluçon managed to get away, no lives taken. The town itself got destroyed as the Dragon Witch let her dragon finish the job in her rage. With no lives lost, hope has been delivered.
n_p2: The groups of Sora and Ritsuka managed to meet up with each other. Sora found out they tried to rush over to try and help them while riding on horses. And much to their relief, everyone was still together. Once again, a blunder on Sora’s part as he forgot to call them and let them know he and Marie were okay, which earned him nothing but teasing from Cú.
n_p3: After the brief reunion, Marie clapped her hands to get everyone’s attention. She told them all how happy she was that she managed to come back to them and thankful she was to Sora, her Hero of Light, earning a surprised blush from him at being put on the spot. She ran over to him and gave him a present. A ring that was similar to the one she’s currently wearing.
n_p4: While Sora was surprised, everyone else looked at it with widened eyes though he didn’t seem to pay it much mind. She told him that she knew about how he lost his Keychains once he got here, earning a laugh from Cú but was thankfully elbowed by Emiya, and she wanted him to use her gift as a Keychain to help start him off in getting new Keyblades.
n_p5: Sora, who was still surprised by the gesture, thanked Marie and took the ring from her. Everyone was watching in anticipation as they watched him place the ring on his Kingdom Key. In sparkles of radiant light and rose pedals, the Keyblade had transformed!
n_p6: Everyone, including those at Chaldea, were awestruck to see it happen before their eyes. Sora did tell them that in every world he visited and every Keychain he collected from them, the forms his Keyblade changed into each serve as representation of that world or even a person.
n_p7: The new Keyblade in Sora’s hand is definitely something that perfectly represents the Queen of France with its elements coming from her.
n_p8: The handle is black with the guard being red, and there was a bow with a crown on it, much like her hat. The length of the blade was long and was the same color as Marie’s hair and was decorated with various glass sparkles. The teeth looked like it was her glass horse, but the maine was facing outward to serve as the teeth shape of the key.
n_p9: Everyone was very impressed with the Keyblade’s design. Sora was thinking about coming up a name for it, though when he said this everyone tried to do it.
n_p10: Thankfully, Amadeus was the one who suggested that Marie should be the one to name the Keyblade. After all, it does represent the bond she has with Sora.
n_p11: Marie was more than happy to take it as she had already thought of a name for the Keyblade. Its name will be…Radiant Sky.
n_p12: After that, the group had a reunion party to celebrate not saving everyone in Montluçon but to also being together again. And it was all thanks to the unique singularity who goes by the name Sora.
